title: Choose the visual world for SahiDana (re-roll: grounded in the paravet's world)
question: Directions drawn from objects paravets, farmers and vets handle every day, fused with SahiDana's solver and tap-to-audit trail.

options.label: Feed-Sack Analysis Panel
options.lineage: Printed cattle-feed sacks (woven polypropylene, two-colour flexo) with their boxed 'typical analysis' panel, feeding instructions and inkjet batch/MRP stamp
options.thesis: Every paravet has read a feed sack's analysis box: SahiDana prints the solved ration as that box, with ruled nutrient rows (required, supplied, coverage), an MRP-style ₹/day block, and an inkjet-stamped solver line; the fine print under each number opens its NDDB/ICAR source.
materials: cool white woven-sack ground (flat, no texture behind numbers)
two-colour flexo: deep fodder green bands, signal-yellow callouts
black ruled analysis box with heavy outer frame
dot-matrix inkjet stamp for solver status and batch line
condensed bold sans caps for heads, tabular figures for every number
options.viewport: Phone at 390px: a green flexo band carries SAHIDANA and the tagline; below it the animal line (Buffalo · 450 kg · 8 L · 6.5% fat) and the feeds-on-hand chips; then the black-framed RATION ANALYSIS box, kg/day per feed, ₹/day in an MRP-style yellow block, five ruled nutrient rows with flat flexo coverage bars, and an inkjet line 'LP OPTIMAL · 5/5 MET · SOLVED 13-10-26'. Every figure carries a small source key.

raised.raise: States stamp onto the sheet and never vanish: INFEASIBLE, VERIFIED and OFFLINE land as rubber-stamp marks over the analysis box.
On a phone the sheet shows only the next decision (animal, then feeds, then Balance) with the primary action fixed at thumb height.
Each feed class owns one full-strength flexo hue (roughage, green fodder, concentrate, mineral), used as the row chip and nowhere else.

options.risk: Sack print can read as feed-company packaging; the build must look like an analysis report, never like an ad for a product to buy, and must keep woven texture away from the numbers for outdoor contrast.

options.label: Milk-Society Slip & Passbook
options.lineage: Village dairy cooperative collection slips and the member passbook (date, shift, litres, fat, SNF, rate, ₹), thermal-printed and purple-stamped
options.thesis: Farmers and paravets already trust the society slip that turns fat % and litres into rupees: SahiDana prints the ration as that slip, ruled passbook columns per feed (kg, ₹/kg, ₹), a totals line, and the society's purple stamp as the verification mark.
materials: white thermal roll with darkened (not grey) print
ruled passbook columns and a double-ruled totals line
purple society rubber stamp for verified and solved states
monospaced figures aligned to the decimal
options.viewport: Phone at 390px: a slip header (SAHIDANA · ration slip · date), the animal line in passbook style, a column table of feeds with kg/day, ₹/kg and ₹, a double rule and the ₹/day total, then the five nutrient rows as required vs supplied, and a purple 'LP OPTIMAL' stamp. Tapping any figure opens its source as a carbon copy beneath.
options.risk: This is my top grounded pick and also the most familiar: receipt aesthetics are common, and thermal-print type must be darkened to pass AA outdoors.

options.label: Acetate Tab-Board Manual
options.lineage: Boxed-software reference manuals with coloured divider boards
options.thesis: Punched acetate leaves over full-strength section boards.
options.viewport: Tabbed manual sections down the fore edge.
options.risk: A software-manual world no paravet recognises.
options.case: Declined: loses audience fit and adds navigation chrome to a one-scroll task.
options.kept: One full-strength hue per feed class.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: Carbon-copy airline coupons and baggage tags
options.thesis: A coupon book where each leg tears off and states stamp themselves.
options.viewport: Coupon stubs stacked down a phone.
options.risk: Air travel is foreign to the paravet's day.
options.case: Declined: loses audience fit; a coupon sequence fragments a ration that must be read whole.
options.kept: States stamp onto the sheet and never vanish.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: One decision per band, gate numbers monumental.
options.viewport: Overhead bands guiding the next step.
options.risk: Signage grammar cannot hold a dense nutrient table.
options.case: Declined: loses audience fit and cannot carry the audit table.
options.kept: On phones, show only the next decision.

canonCard.label: Clean Agricultural SaaS Utility
canonCard.thesis: Standard modern mobile form and table UI with emerald accents and clean cards.
canonCard.viewport: Standard mobile SaaS layout with form cards and progress bars.
canonCard.risk: Looks like a generic dashboard template unless citation pills stand out.
